questions.question: Clarify the official name of the council of rectors in whose work Nuzhin participated.

localizations.source: Clarify the official name of the council of rectors in whose work Nuzhin participated.
localizations.ru: Уточнить официальное наименование совета ректоров, в работе которого участвовал Нужин.

questions.resolution: Because the sources disagree, the disputed official title was replaced by a neutral statement about coordinating the work of rectors.

questions.question: Check attribution of the personal postscript and consistency of English names and the honorary title.

localizations.source: Check attribution of the personal postscript and consistency of English names and the honorary title.
localizations.ru: Проверить атрибуцию личного послесловия и согласованность английских написаний имён и звания.

questions.resolution: The postscript remains the author’s first-person statement in Mansur Gilmullin’s article; the English version is aligned with the Russian text in meaning and names.

questions.question: Identify a public or institutional source, photographer or archive, and a valid legal basis for reproducing the portrait of Mikhail Nuzhin.

localizations.source: Identify a public or institutional source, photographer or archive, and a valid legal basis for reproducing the portrait of Mikhail Nuzhin.
localizations.ru: Установить публичный или институциональный источник, фотографа или архив и действительное правовое основание воспроизведения портрета М. Т. Нужина.

questions.question: Reconcile the start of Nuzhin’s wartime service: the article says that he fought from September 1942, while Kazan Federal University’s biography places him in the 831st Artillery Regiment from June 1942; distinguish assignment to the unit from entry into combat and cite the evidence.

localizations.source: Reconcile the start of Nuzhin’s wartime service: the article says that he fought from September 1942, while Kazan Federal University’s biography places him in the 831st Artillery Regiment from June 1942; distinguish assignment to the unit from entry into combat and cite the evidence.
localizations.ru: Сверить начало военной службы Нужина: статья указывает участие в боях с сентября 1942 года, а биография КФУ — службу в 831-м артиллерийском полку с июня 1942 года; разграничить назначение в часть и начало боевого участия и привести основание.
